sources.snippet: PromptSentinel Author: Rahil Dobariya Contact: rahildobariya2024@gmail.com A real-time LLM safety classifier and output drift monitor built entirely from scratch. sources.title: srikanthgali/paradetect-deberta-v3-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ParaDetect is a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-large model using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) for detecting AI-generated vs human-written text. This model achieves ~99% accuracy in distinguishing between human and AI-generated content, making it highly effective for academic integrity, content verification, and research applications.
